subject: Intro + Kickoff scheduling for Avery Solutions onboarding
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <scarter@averysolutions.com>, Onboarding Team <onboarding@averysolutions.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & kickoff: Redwood Inference onboarding for Avery Solutions

Hi Sam + Avery onboarding team,

Great to meet you all virtually — excited to get Avery onboarded with Redwood. I wanted to propose we lock a 60-minute kickoff next week to align on goals, success metrics, and the implementation runbook. Suggested outcomes:
- Confirm primary use cases and acceptance criteria
- Identify networking / security owners for Private deployment (if applicable)
- Review timeline, milestones, and responsibilities (MAP)
- Agree on next steps and repository of shared artifacts

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed Mar 11 • 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu Mar 12 • 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00

Suggested attendees (we can adjust):
- Sam Carter — Product Lead (Avery)
- Thomas Nguyen — IT/Security
- Soojin Lee — Solutions Engineer (Redwood)
- Rachel Kim — Customer Success Manager (Redwood)
- Neha Kapoor — Integration Engineer (Redwood)

I've attached a short draft agenda and a mutual action plan template to make the meeting productive. If you prefer a different time window, let me know and we can accommodate. Once we confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite with a Google Meet + a Miro board for the architecture/topology discussion.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: Redwood-Onboarding-Agenda-v1.pdf (agenda, 1 page); Avery-MAP-template.xlsx (mutual action plan template)
From: Sam Carter <scarter@averysolutions.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Onboarding Team <onboarding@averysolutions.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro & kickoff: Redwood Inference onboarding for Avery Solutions

Thanks Soojin — this looks good. We can do Wed Mar 11 at 10:00–11:00 PST. Attendees I'll add: myself (Product), Thomas Nguyen (IT/Security), and my engineering manager Priya Shah may join depending on availability.

A couple quick notes before the call:
- We are planning a hybrid deployment (staging hosted, prod private in our AWS VPC) so we'll want to cover VPC peering and KMS keyhanding on the call.
- Our procurement team has a standard NDA in flight; procurement contact is onboarding@averysolutions.com — happy to loop them into the kickoff if that helps.

If all good, go ahead and send the invite.

—Sam
Sam Carter
Senior Product Manager, Avery Solutions
scarter@averysolutions.com | (206) 555-0147

2) Use-cases / success criteria (10m)

Thanks — invite should show up shortly.

Soojin
